heading: New engine

basics.name: Engine name
basics.briefHint: Describe the objective, tone, what to say and what to avoid, and any links. This becomes the AI's instructions, so the more specific, the better.
basics.briefPlaceholder: You are re-engaging {{learners}} who stopped attending. Be warm and brief…

agent.heading: From the Lead Agent “{{name}}”:
agent.filled: Filled from the Lead Agent {{names}}. Edit it freely.
agent.use: Use the Lead Agent’s description as the brief

ai.title: Write it with AI
ai.hint: The AI drafts the brief from your product details. It can't open the website; the address is used as the link to share. Gaps appear as TODO lines.
ai.productPlaceholder: What it is, who it's for, why it helps…
ai.needInput: Add the objective, the product or the website first.

dataPoints.intro: Choose what the AI may look at for each person, like attendance or fee dues. More information means better-timed messages.
dataPoints.consent: I confirm this institute has consent to use the sensitive data points above for messaging.

channels.intro: Pick the channels to use. You approve every message at first. WhatsApp needs Meta-approved templates (set up after creating).
channels.auto: Auto-send proactively (after this channel graduates; until then you review and send each one)
channels.autoReply: Auto-answer replies (AI replies within 24h; money, anger, requests to stop and uncertainty always come to you)
channels.autoHint: Sends without asking once you've approved the first few.
channels.autoReplyHint: AI answers replies within 24h. Money, anger, stop requests or doubt come to you.
channels.callNote: Calls leads with an AI agent from the pool you pick.
channels.whatsappNote: Needs Meta-approved templates, proposed by the AI after you create the engine.

audience.intro: Pick who this engine should reach. Tick as many {{batches}} and {{audiences}} as you like.
audience.batchesHint: Everyone enrolled in the ticked ones.
audience.dedupNote: Someone in more than one is contacted only once.

picker.moreLists: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Type a name to find the others.

cadence.recheck: How often to reach each person
cadence.recheckHint: At most this often per person. The AI may skip a touch that would not help.
cadence.rhythmHint: Pick a time and days, so you always know when messages go out.
cadence.sendTimeHint: Planned messages go out within an hour of this time, in the timezone you pick.
cadence.daysHint: No planned messages on the other days. Replies are still answered.
cadence.firstTouchNowHint: A new lead within 15 minutes; a whole list you add within the hour. Always inside the allowed hours and days.
cadence.firstTouchWaitHint: Their first message goes out in the next send window.
cadence.stopOnMeeting: Stop when a meeting is booked
cadence.stopOnMeetingHint: Ends outreach to that lead and cancels pending messages.
cadence.bookingPageHint: Books a demo at the time a lead asks, or offers free slots. Reschedules too.
cadence.bookingPageEmpty: No booking pages yet. Create one in Meetings to let the engine book demos.
cadence.quietHint: No messages between these hours, in the timezone below. The institute's own quiet-hours floor still applies on top of this.

autonomy.title: Advanced settings
autonomy.hint: Optional. When channels start sending on their own, and a test group.
autonomy.firstNHint: For channels set to send on their own: you approve this many of their messages first, then the channel sends by itself. Leave blank for 5.
autonomy.holdoutHint: This share of people is added but never messaged, so you can compare and see whether the engine helps. Leave 0 if unsure.

review.name: Name
review.goalNone: Until converted, not interested or asked to stop
review.draftNote: The engine starts as a Draft. After creating it, add the people and (for WhatsApp) approve templates, then activate it.

enroll.title: Add the people
enroll.text: Press “Add people now” on the engine page to bring in the people you picked.

templates.title: Approve WhatsApp templates
templates.text: The AI proposes them; you approve and submit; Meta reviews.

activate.title: Dry run, then activate
activate.text: A dry run shows sample drafts in the task inbox without sending anything.

errors.nameAndBrief: An engine needs a name and a brief.

subtitle: Six short steps. You can review everything before it is created — nothing is sent until you activate it.

blocked.name: Give the engine a name to continue.
blocked.consent: Tick the consent box to continue.
blocked.channel: Turn on at least one channel to continue.
blocked.audience: Tick at least one of your {{batches}} or {{audiences}} to continue.
blocked.cadence: Choose how often to check in.
blocked.channelNotReady: {{channel}} is not set up for your institute. Set it up, or turn the channel off to continue.
blocked.days: Pick at least one day to continue.
blocked.sendTimeQuiet: The send time is inside the quiet hours. Pick a time outside them.
blocked.aiCallPool: Pick at least one AI agent for AI call, or turn it off to continue.

leaveDialog.title: Leave without saving?
leaveDialog.description: What you have filled in so far will be lost.
leaveDialog.editDescription: Your changes to this engine will not be saved.

assetsStep.lead: Optional. Material the agent can send on WhatsApp when a lead asks. Add more later from the engine page.
assetsStep.editLead: Material the agent can send on WhatsApp when a lead asks. Changes save immediately.

team.title: Who to alert and book meetings with
team.hint: Alerted (in-app and email) when the agent can't handle a reply or lacks requested material. Meetings use their Google account from My Schedule, else the institute default. The lead's counsellor is always told too.
team.loadFailed: Couldn't load your team. Try again in a moment.

aiCall.note: Calls rotate through the agents you pick, one per call.
aiCall.loadFailed: Couldn't load your AI agents. Try again in a moment.
